messages:
nora (docs): Heads up: we're changing the license on the public SDK samples repo to Apache-2.0 and adding a lightweight contributor process (DCO signoff or CLA) to improve reuse clarity. Posting summary + timeline here for visibility. :scroll:

eli (eng): Can you summarize the reason? We have community PRs coming in and some customers embed samples into products.

nora (docs): Primary reasons: 1) clarify reuse permissions for customers and partners, 2) make it safe to publish reference implementations on the website, 3) allow downstream packaging without legal ambiguity. This is not changing SDK runtime licensing.

jamal (legal): Quick clarifier: samples repo -> Apache-2.0. SDK packages remain unchanged. CLA/DCO helps us ensure contributors confirm they own submitted code. No surprises for customers.

riley (devex): Implementation plan from infra/devex: add license-bot to require signoff on PRs, add a CONTRIBUTING.md with a one-click CLA link, and add a lightweight license header check in CI.

nora (docs): Docs changes we need:
- Update /docs/samples landing with new license badge and short FAQ ("what can I reuse?")
- Add a short section in SDK quickstart: "Using samples in production" with recommended checklist
- Add a callout in any copy-pasted snippets that sensitive data must be redacted
Target: publish docs updates within 5 business days.

eli (eng): For the samples themselves: do we need to scrub history for any problematic commits?

jamal (legal): We'll run a repo scan. If we find third-party code with incompatible terms we will either remove or relicense those files separately. We'll surface any hits to repo owners.

riley (devex): CI changes: license header linter + a bot comment that links to the CLA on the contributor's first PR. We'll run the checks in a non-blocking mode for 2 weeks to avoid disruption.

license-bot: New rule applied: require-license-header. Mode: warning (non-blocking) until 2026-04-15.

nora (docs): Public-facing messaging: short blog post + changelog entry and a pinned issue in the samples repo describing the contributor flow. I'll draft copy and share for review.

eli (eng): One more ask: update code snippets in the docs to include an explicit license comment at the top so customers who copy-paste know the license immediately. Example: `# Licensed under the Apache-2.0 license` or `// Apache-2.0`

nora (docs): Good call. We'll add a small snippet linter rule to detect missing license header in docs code blocks. Small scope: only code blocks in /docs/samples and /docs/quickstarts.

jamal (legal): Timeline recap: today: policy announced; 3 days: CONTRIBUTING.md + CLA link live; 5 days: docs updates; 14 days: license header linter enforced; 30 days: non-owners notified and repo history scan complete. Flag any external partner repos that need special handling.

eli (eng): Will create template PRs to add headers to the biggest examples. Also will tag partner repos that embed samples so we can coordinate.

riley (devex): We'll run a sweep script to add SPDX headers to top-level example files and open PRs automatically (bot-authored). Non-invasive edits only.

nora (docs): Action items (owners):
- nora: draft blog + FAQ (3 days)
- riley: add license-bot + CI rule, sweep script (5 days)
- eli: template PRs & partner notification (7 days)
- jamal: run repo scan and review hits (14 days)

docs-bot: Created page: /docs/announcements/samples-license-update and updated samples README with CONTRIBUTING.md link.

nora (docs): Thanks all. If any teams need an exception for partner reasons, please escalate to jamal + nora. We'll host an office hours drop-in next Tuesday to walk through the process. :calendar:
